About Caspian Sea

Caspian Sea is a desi, BBQ and Chinese restaurant in Johar Town, Lahore, serving since 2002. It is located at 76 G-II, Canal Bank Road, near Emporium Mall and Khokhar Chowk, with 2 floors and a rooftop with a canal view.

  • Desi, BBQ and Chinese — all under one roof
  • Rooftop seating with a canal view
  • Live music and a lunch buffet
  • Banquet hall
